# Checks

86 checks, grouped by domain.

The **ID is stable for the lifetime of a check** and does not change when the
check or the tool behind it is renamed, so it can be cited in an audit trail.

The **ATT&CK** column is empty for checks that report inventory or hygiene rather
than the detection of an attack technique; no technique is listed unless the check
detects it.

A report's framework coverage counts only the checks that ran. A check that could
not run contributes no coverage.
